description: Rewrite the React class component in app.jsx in place as a function component on useState/useEffect with complete dependency arrays and timer cleanup on unmount, keeping the same fetch, polling, filter and auto-refresh behavior and the same rendered markup with no class left behind.

criteria: app.jsx is a function component with the state fields in useState, the feed fetch and the polling timer in separate useEffect hooks with complete dependency arrays, clearInterval cleanup on every effect re-run and on unmount, polling running only while auto-refresh is on and restarted when refreshInterval changes, the same rendered markup, class names, props and defaults as before, and no class component, constructor or lifecycle method remaining.
